statement: Community notes describe full 0x30 Pro Controller reports at a nominal 120 Hz (~8.33 ms), while other controller modes are described at 60 Hz. The 0x03 subcommand note says standard full mode pushes at 60 Hz, without distinguishing Pro in that section.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: bluetooth_hid_notes.md 116-118; bluetooth_hid_subcommands_notes.md 66-78. Community documentation has divergent general/Pro cadence statements; specifically USB cadence not independently measured.
